item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q009_heme_bundle_fold_not_homology","answer":"No. In SCOPe 2.08 these proteins meet only at the fold level: class f, \"Membrane and cell surface proteins and peptides\", fold f.21, SUNID 81344, \"Heme-binding four-helical bundle\". SCOPe splits the three named groups into three sibling superfamilies under that fold: f.21.1, SUNID 81342, \"Transmembrane di-heme cytochromes\"; f.21.2, SUNID 81343, \"Fumarate reductase respiratory complex transmembrane subunits\"; and f.21.3, SUNID 103501, \"Respiratory nitrate reductase 1 gamma chain\". Thus the shared heme-binding four-helix-bundle architecture supports a same-fold structural relationship, but SCOPe does not assert one homologous superfamily spanning the di-heme cytochromes, fumarate-reductase transmembrane subunits, and nitrate-reductase gamma chains. They should be treated as cross-superfamily, same-fold representatives: acceptable for a negative homology control, but unsafe for superfamily-level homology claims, direct function transfer, or assuming a template from one of the three carries the evolutionary and family-specific features of another.","evidence_used":["list_scop_children: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21/children?limit=100","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.1","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.1/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.2","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.2/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.3","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.3/parents"]}]}
